items.title: Is Oracle (ORCL) Turning AI Governance Into Its Next Competitive Moat With Fusion Claw?

items.title: How Much Upside Is Left In Microsoft Stock?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) shares returned 37% over the past three months, against 2.6% for the S&P 500. Even so, Microsoft's P/E, the price divided by a year of profit, is 28.3. That is below 31.8, the stock's average at the last twelve quarter-ends, leaving out readings above 100. A run that big makes buyers wary, but the shares cost less per dollar of profit than usual. So how much upside is left in Microsoft stock at today's price.

items.title: Why Is Everyone Ignoring Adobe Stock's High Cash Yield?
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) stock now trades about 58% below its two-year high, set in December 2024. Free cash flow is the cash left after running costs and spending on equipment. At that price, Adobe's yearly free cash flow equals 11.5% of its market value. The median S&P 500 company's free cash flow equals 4.5% of its market value.
